customer: Caller, a veteran leasing a midsize SUV in Brevin, was upset that his lease through Crescent Motor Credit apparently can't be bought out by Northwind and wanted to know why he's stuck.
agent: Customer asked whether we could buy out his Crescent Motor Credit lease on his midsize SUV; explained per 'Which leasing companies allow third-party buyouts' that Crescent Motor Credit does not allow third-party buyouts. Advised he can buy the vehicle out himself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease. Referred him to 'Selling vs. turning in at lease end' to compare those options.
